LanguageData.CC_Settings_Connection_ShowDormantConnec: Pawns will show that they have a dormant Connection in their inspect window. Won't show what it exactly is.
LanguageData.CC_Settings_DisableEmpire_Description: When enabled, the Empire faction (Royalty DLC) will not appear during Cosmere scenario world generation.
LanguageData.CC_Settings_DisableOdyssey_Label: Disable Odyssey Factions in Cosmere Scenarios
LanguageData.CC_Settings_DisableOdyssey_Description: When enabled, Mechanoid Hive and Insect Geneline factions (Odyssey DLC) will not appear during Cosmere scenario world generation.
LanguageData.CC_Settings_RadialAnchorMouse_Descriptio: When enabled the ability radial opens centered on the mouse cursor. When disabled it opens centered on the selected pawn.
LanguageData.CC_Settings_LogLevel_Description: Determines what gets logged. Should probably be Info
LanguageData.CC_Settings_Quickstarter_Description: When in dev mode, will immediately launch into the given Quickstarter. Very useful for testing.
LanguageData.CC_Settings_TestScenario_Description: Scenario used by the ScenarioTestQuickstart. Lets you boot straight into any scenario with default pawn generation.
LanguageData.CC_Settings_RadialPause_Description: Halt time while the ability wheel is open, and resume at the same speed when it closes. A game already paused stays paused.
LanguageData.CC_Settings_ResetDockPosition_Descriptio: The dock can be dragged anywhere on screen. Reset it to return it to the left edge.
LanguageData.CC_Settings_DockSectionMaxHeight_Descrip: How tall an open section of the investiture dock may grow before it scrolls instead. A Mistborn burns sixteen metals, and the whole table will not fit on a short screen.
LanguageData.CC_Settings_ReduceMotion_Description: Stops pulsing and breathing animations on lit panels.
LanguageData.CC_Settings_HighContrast_Description: Brightens system accents and strengthens panel borders.
LanguageData.CC_Settings_System_Empty: This system has no visible settings.
